heading: Heading
dropFile: Drop to open a Markdown file
unsaved: Draft not saved. Save your MD file.
emptyDescription: Write Markdown to see a preview.
pagedDescription: Split at the chosen page height
singleDescription: Height expands to fit the content
exportNote: Selectable text, with formulas and syntax highlighting.
helpIntro: Supports headings, tables, task lists, blockquotes, links, images, and syntax highlighting.
imageHelp: Use the image button or paste to embed local images. Use embedded images instead of relative file paths; they are saved inside your Markdown file.
helpNote: Drafts are stored in this browser; use “Save MD” for important documents. KaTeX renders LaTeX math; full .tex documents are not supported.
fileTooLarge: The file exceeds 16 MB. Reduce its size and try again.
fileReadFailed: Could not read the file. Try again.
imageType: Supported image formats: PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP.
imageTooLarge: Each image must be 5 MB or smaller.
imageEmbedded: Image embedded. It will be included in the export.
confirmNew: A new document will replace this draft. Save any Markdown you want to keep first. Continue?
confirmExample: Loading the example will replace this draft. Save any Markdown you want to keep first. Continue?
errorNetwork: Could not connect to the PDF export service. Try again later.
errorPayload: Export parameters must be an object.
errorEmpty: Write something before exporting a PDF.
errorDocumentSize: Keep the document and embedded images within 16 MB.
errorMargin: Margins are too large. Content must be at least 40 mm wide.
errorTheme: This document style is not supported.
errorMethod: This request method is not supported.
errorPost: Use POST to export a PDF.
errorRateLimit: Too many exports. Try again in one minute.
errorLocalBusy: Other exports are in progress. Try again later.
errorTimeout: PDF export timed out. Check the images or shorten the document and try again.
errorExport: PDF export failed. Try again later.
errorSize: The document or image exceeds the size limit.
errorImages: Some images could not load. Check their URLs or embed local images and try again.
errorOverflow: Some formulas or tables exceed the content width. Increase page width, reduce font size, or split long formulas.
errorHeight: The document exceeds the 5080 mm single-page limit. Increase page width or use multiple pages.
errorBrowser: No browser found. Install Google Chrome or run python -m playwright install chromium.
